item.title: 英语学习 - The Strategy of Protest and Revolution 1: Basic Elements (04/05/2020) - 2026-05-02 15:14
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：107 分钟 (5309 字符)

原文 阅读解析 翻译参考 词汇 表达讲解
Movements don’t have unlimited resources, so they have to make choices on what they will prioritize to maximize power. Movements / don’t have / unlimited resources, / so / they / have to / make choices / on / what / they / will prioritize / to / maximize power. 运动没有无限的资源，所以它们必须在优先考虑什么以使权力最大化上做出选择。 unlimited: 无限的
prioritize: 优先处理
maximize: 使最大化		 “have to”表示客观必要性；“on what...”引导宾语从句作为choices的范围。
At the highest, most abstract level of grand strategy, movements look at the social movement process and choose whether they want to prioritize participation, or prioritize contribution. At / the highest, / most abstract level / of / grand strategy, / movements / look at / the social movement process / and / choose / whether / they / want to / prioritize / participation, / or / prioritize / contribution. 在大战略的最高、最抽象层面上，运动观察社会运动过程，并选择是想优先考虑参与，还是优先考虑贡献。 abstract: 抽象的
grand strategy: 大战略
participation: 参与
contribution: 贡献		 “whether... or...”引导选择性宾语从句。
This corresponds to the two basic elements within a social movement: Issues and Organization. This / corresponds to / the two basic elements / within / a social movement: / Issues / and / Organization. 这对应于社会运动中的两个基本要素：议题和组织。 correspond to: 对应于
element: 要素		 冒号用于引出具体的两个要素。
Issues focus on participation. Issues / focus on / participation. 议题专注于参与。 focus on: 专注于 主语+谓语+宾语的简单结构。
An issue is a problem-and-solution combo: the movement highlights a problem, proposes a solution, and sells the package to the public. An issue / is / a problem-and-solution combo: / the movement / highlights / a problem, / proposes / a solution, / and / sells / the package / to / the public. 一个议题是一个“问题与解决方案”的组合：运动突出一个问题，提议一个解决方案，并将这个整套方案推销给公众。 combo: 组合/套餐
highlight: 强调/突出
propose: 提议
package: 整套方案		 “sells... to the public”形象地描述了政治传播的过程。
Because issues are ideas, they can reach people who are normally beyond a movement’s social or geographic environment. Because / issues / are / ideas, / they / can / reach / people / who / are normally / beyond / a movement’s / social / or / geographic environment. 因为议题是思想，它们可以触及那些通常在运动的社会或地理环境之外的人。 reach: 触及/到达
beyond: 超出...范围
geographic: 地理的		 “who”引导定语从句修饰people。
A good issue turns those people into participants, allowing a movement to rapidly gain scale and establish a large base of support that establishments will find hard to ignore. A good issue / turns / those people / into / participants, / allowing / a movement / to / rapidly / gain scale / and / establish / a large base of support / that / establishments / will find / hard to ignore. 一个好的议题将那些人转变为参与者，使运动能够迅速扩大规模并建立一个建制派难以忽视的巨大支持基础。 turn into: 变成
scale: 规模
establishment: 建制/当权派
ignore: 忽视		 “allowing...”现在分词作结果状语；“find hard to ignore”是find+宾语+宾补结构。
So what’s a good issue? The best problems tend to be things that the public actually recognizes as a problem, and an urgent one at that. So / what’s / a good issue? / The best problems / tend to / be / things / that / the public / actually / recognizes / as / a problem, / and / an urgent one / at that. 那么什么是好的议题？最好的问题往往是公众确实认为是个问题的事情，而且还是个紧迫的问题。 tend to: 倾向于
recognize: 认可/识别
urgent: 紧急的		 “at that”在此表示“而且、在那一点上”，用于加强语气。
This combination usually only happens when there is some dramatic failure that focuses attention on the issue at hand. This combination / usually / only happens / when / there is / some dramatic failure / that / focuses / attention / on / the issue / at hand. 这种结合通常只在出现某种引人注目的失败、将注意力集中在眼前的问题上时才会发生。 dramatic: 戏剧性的/引人注目的
at hand: 手头的/眼前的		 “focus attention on”固定搭配，意为“集中注意力于”。
Examples could be the Stonewall Riots for the US gay rights movement, or the Shah’s violent suppression of religious students in the Iranian Revolution. Examples / could be / the Stonewall Riots / for / the US gay rights movement, / or / the Shah’s / violent suppression / of / religious students / in / the Iranian Revolution. 例子可以是美国民权运动中的石墙暴动，或者是伊朗革命中沙阿对宗教学生的暴力镇压。 riot: 暴乱/暴动
suppression: 镇压
religious: 宗教的		 列举具体历史事件作为“dramatic failure”的例证。
A good solution is a bit more complicated. A good solution / is / a bit / more complicated. 一个好的解决方案要更复杂一些。 complicated: 复杂的 “a bit more”修饰比较级。
One hypothesis is that the public compares the movement’s policy position with what the establishment is offering, which is usually the status quo. One hypothesis / is / that / the public / compares / the movement’s / policy position / with / what / the establishment / is offering, / which / is / usually / the status quo. 一种假设是公众将运动的政策立场与建制派提供的方案进行比较，而后者通常是现状。 hypothesis: 假设
compare... with...: 比较
status quo: 现状		 “which”引导非限制性定语从句，修饰前面的offering（即建制派提供的方案）。
If the movement’s solution isn’t that different to the establishment position, people won’t see enough benefit to overcome the costs of fighting the establishment. If / the movement’s solution / isn’t / that different / to / the establishment position, / people / won’t see / enough benefit / to / overcome / the costs / of / fighting / the establishment. 如果运动的解决方案与建制派的立场没有那么大的不同，人们就不会看到足够的利益来克服对抗建制派的代价。 different to/from: 不同于
overcome: 克服
cost: 代价/成本		 “enough... to...”结构，表示“足够...以至于”。
On the other hand, if there is too much change, people will also worry that the result will wipe out the benefits they do get from the status quo, and again they won’t join. On the other hand, / if / there is / too much change, / people / will also worry / that / the result / will / wipe out / the benefits / they / do get / from / the status quo, / and / again / they / won’t join. 另一方面，如果变革太大，人们也会担心结果会抹杀他们确实从现状中获得的利益，从而再次选择不加入。 on the other hand: 另一方面
wipe out: 彻底消除/抹除		 “they do get”中的do起强调作用。
So in the end, the most attractive solution is usually one that offers a moderate amount of change from the establishment position. So / in the end, / the most attractive solution / is / usually / one / that / offers / a moderate amount / of / change / from / the establishment position. 所以最终，最吸引人的解决方案通常是那个相对于建制派立场提供适度变革的方案。 attractive: 有吸引力的
moderate: 适度的/温和的		 “one”指代前面的solution。
This is, of course, not what ideological purists want to hear. This / is, / of course, / not / what / ideological purists / want / to hear. 当然，这不是意识形态纯洁主义者想要听到的。 ideological: 意识形态的
purist: 纯洁主义者		 “what”引导表语从句。
But there are ways for them to win on issues. But / there are / ways / for them / to win / on issues. 但他们也有办法在议题上获胜。 win on: 在...方面获胜 “there are ways for sb to do sth”句型。
They can, for example, radicalize in phases like the French Revolution, shifting into major changes one moderate step at a time; or they can frame their demands in moderate terms: Lenin’s Land, Bread and Peace instead of the Communist Manifesto. They / can, / for example, / radicalize / in phases / like / the French Revolution, / shifting / into / major changes / one moderate step / at a time; / or / they / can / frame / their demands / in / moderate terms: / Lenin’s / Land, Bread and Peace / instead of / the Communist Manifesto. 例如，他们可以像法国大革命那样分阶段激进化，一次一小步地转向重大变革；或者他们可以用温和的措辞来构筑他们的诉求：比如列宁的“土地、面包与和平”，而不是《共产党宣言》。 radicalize: 激进化
in phases: 分阶段地
frame: 构筑/框架
term: 措辞/条款		 “one... at a time”意为“一次...”。
Cynical, perhaps, but in the end, it’s all to maximize public participation, and that’s what issues are all about. Cynical, / perhaps, / but / in the end, / it’s / all / to maximize / public participation, / and / that’s / what / issues / are all about. 也许这很愤世嫉俗，但最终，这一切都是为了最大化公众参与，而这正是议题的全部意义所在。 cynical: 愤世嫉俗的/犬儒的
be all about: 关键在于/全部意义在于		 “what... is all about”是固定表达，指某事的核心本质。
Let’s now turn to Organization, which focuses on the contribution part of the social movement process. Let’s / now / turn to / Organization, / which / focuses on / the contribution part / of / the social movement process. 现在让我们转向“组织”，它专注于社会运动过程中的“贡献”部分。 turn to: 转向/开始讨论 “which”引导非限制性定语从句修饰Organization。
The idea of contribution works like this: a movement can attract a million participants, but if all they do is give verbal support, then that’s no real threat to the establishment. The idea / of contribution / works / like this: / a movement / can / attract / a million participants, / but / if / all / they do / is / give / verbal support, / then / that’s / no real threat / to / the establishment. “贡献”的理念是这样的：一个运动可以吸引一百万参与者，但如果他们所做的只是口头支持，那么对建制派就没有真正的威胁。 attract: 吸引
verbal: 口头的
threat: 威胁		 “all they do is (to) give”中，当主语含do时，不定式to常省略。
It’s certainly less of a threat than 10,000 participants that reliably vote or strike or bomb if their demands are not met. It’s / certainly / less of a threat / than / 10,000 / participants / that / reliably / vote / or / strike / or / bomb / if / their demands / are not met. 这当然比不上一万名在诉求得不到满足时能可靠地投票、罢工或投掷炸弹的参与者那样的威胁。 reliably: 可靠地
strike: 罢工
meet demands: 满足诉求		 “less of a ... than ...”表示“比...更谈不上是...”。
So contribution is basically how much and how far participants will act for the movement. So / contribution / is / basically / how much / and / how far / participants / will act / for / the movement. 所以贡献基本上就是参与者为运动行动的程度和深度。 basically: 基本上
how far: 到什么程度		 “how much and how far”引导表语从句。
But action is inherently costly, whether in terms of sacrificing leisure time or facing down state suppression, and the average participant is generally not fanatical enough to bear this cost by themselves. But / action / is / inherently / costly, / whether / in terms of / sacrificing / leisure time / or / facing down / state suppression, / and / the average participant / is / generally / not / fanatical enough / to / bear / this cost / by themselves. 但行动本质上是代价高昂的，无论是牺牲闲暇时间还是直面国家镇压，而普通参与者通常不够狂热，无法独自承担这种代价。 inherently: 本质上地
sacrifice: 牺牲
leisure: 闲暇
fanatical: 狂热的		 “whether... or...”引导让步状语；“adj + enough to do”结构。
Organization helps by pooling, coordinating and distributing the collective resources that participants bring to the movement. Organization / helps / by / pooling, / coordinating / and / distributing / the collective resources / that / participants / bring / to / the movement. 组织通过汇集、协调和分配参与者带给运动的集体资源来提供帮助。 pool: 汇集
coordinate: 协调
distribute: 分配
collective: 集体的		 by + v-ing 结构表示手段或方式。
Good organization lowers the cost of action, which increases the frequency and extent of action and, in the end, the power that the movement generates per participant. Good organization / lowers / the cost / of / action, / which / increases / the frequency / and / extent / of / action / and, / in the end, / the power / that / the movement / generates / per participant. 良好的组织降低了行动成本，从而增加了行动的频率和范围，并最终增加了运动在每个参与者身上产生的力量。 frequency: 频率
extent: 程度/范围
generate: 产生		 “which”指代前面整个句子（组织降低成本这件事）。
So what’s good organization? As this video series will show, it depends on the circumstances. So / what’s / good organization? / As / this video series / will show, / it / depends on / the circumstances. 那么什么是良好的组织？正如本视频系列将展示的那样，这取决于具体情况。 depend on: 取决于
circumstance: 情况/环境		 “As”引导定语从句，意为“正如...”。
By themselves, top-town hierarchies with specializations and command structures tend to use resources more efficiently, especially compared with bottom-up networks of independent cells that duplicate processes and have to negotiate with each other to get things done. By themselves, / top-town hierarchies / with / specializations / and / command structures / tend to / use / resources / more efficiently, / especially / compared with / bottom-up networks / of / independent cells / that / duplicate / processes / and / have to / negotiate / with / each other / to / get things done. 就其本身而言，具有专业化和指挥结构的自上而下的层级制往往能更有效地利用资源，特别是与那些重复流程且必须相互协商才能完成任务的、由独立单元组成的自下而上的网络相比。 hierarchy: 层级制
specialization: 专业化
duplicate: 重复/复制
negotiate: 谈判/协商		 “top-down” vs “bottom-up” 是一对反义词。
That’s why movements in tolerant political environments tend to become bureaucracies, like European trade unions or the US National Rifle Association. That’s / why / movements / in / tolerant / political environments / tend to / become / bureaucracies, / like / European / trade unions / or / the US National Rifle Association. 这就是为什么在宽容的政治环境中的运动往往会变成官僚机构，比如欧洲的工会或美国的全国步枪协会。 tolerant: 宽容的
bureaucracy: 官僚机构
trade union: 工会		 “That’s why...”引导结果从句。
But in an intolerant environment, centralization would expose the movement to a crippling leadership strike, and in any case, the establishment wouldn’t have let the movement raise the resources to develop and maintain these expensive bureaucracies. But / in / an intolerant environment, / centralization / would / expose / the movement / to / a crippling leadership strike, / and / in any case, / the establishment / wouldn’t / have let / the movement / raise / the resources / to / develop / and / maintain / these expensive bureaucracies. 但在不宽容的环境中，集权会使运动面临毁灭性的领导层打击，而且无论如何，建制派也不会让运动筹集资源来发展和维持这些昂贵的官僚机构。 centralization: 集权
crippling: 毁灭性的/致残的
maintain: 维持		 “expose A to B”使A暴露在B（危险）之下。
There is also an ideological aspect to organization. There / is / also / an ideological aspect / to / organization. 组织还有一个意识形态方面。 aspect: 方面 There be 句型。
Because bottom-up organization have weak or no centralized leadership, decisions tend to reflect a more moderate and flexible ideology that represents the majority of participants, which is, of course, an ideologue’s nightmare. Because / bottom-up organization / have / weak / or / no centralized leadership, / decisions / tend to / reflect / a more moderate / and / flexible ideology / that / represents / the majority / of / participants, / which / is, / of course, / an ideologue’s nightmare. 由于自下而上的组织领导力薄弱或没有集中的领导，决策往往反映出一种更温和、更灵活的意识形态，代表了大多数参与者，这当然是意识形态家的噩梦。 flexible: 灵活的
represent: 代表
ideologue: 意识形态家
nightmare: 噩梦		 “which”修饰前面提到的“决策反映温和意识形态”这一情况。
One thing to remember in social movements is that activists don’t just fight the establishment, they also fight each other, and that will be a recurring theme in this video series. One thing / to remember / in / social movements / is / that / activists / don’t just / fight / the establishment, / they / also / fight / each other, / and / that / will be / a recurring theme / in / this video series. 在社会运动中要记住的一点是，活动家们不仅与建制派斗争，他们也相互斗争，而这将是本视频系列中反复出现的主题。 activist: 活动家
recurring: 反复出现的		 “not just... (but) also...” 递进结构。
3 Types of Grand Strategy 3 Types / of / Grand Strategy 三种大战略类型 type: 类型 小标题结构。
So, we’ve seen how issues and organization influence the social movement process. So, / we’ve seen / how / issues / and / organization / influence / the social movement process. 所以，我们已经看到了议题和组织是如何影响社会运动过程的。 influence: 影响 “how”引导宾语从句。
Now, we’ll use them to analyze the three stages of social movement grand strategy, each exemplified by a major historical revolution. Now, / we’ll use / them / to / analyze / the three stages / of / social movement / grand strategy, / each / exemplified / by / a major / historical revolution. 现在，我们将利用它们来分析社会运动大战略的三个阶段，每个阶段都以一个重大的历史革命为例。 analyze: 分析
exemplify: 举例说明/例证		 “each exemplified by...”是独立主格结构，作补充说明。
The first stage is Spontaneous Uprising, exemplified by the French Revolution. The first stage / is / Spontaneous Uprising, / exemplified / by / the French Revolution. 第一阶段是自发性起义，以法国大革命为例。 spontaneous: 自发的
uprising: 起义		 过去分词短语作后置定语。
This is a high issue, low-organization grand strategy, where the movement positions itself on such a hot-button issue, that the public spontaneously and massively rises up in an explosion of support. This / is / a high issue, / low-organization / grand strategy, / where / the movement / positions / itself / on / such / a hot-button issue, / that / the public / spontaneously / and / massively / rises up / in / an explosion / of / support. 这是一种“高议题、低组织”的大战略，在这种战略中，运动将自己定位在一个如此敏感的热点问题上，以至于公众会自发地、大规模地在支持的爆发中起义。 hot-button: 敏感的/引起激烈争论的
massively: 大规模地		 “where”引导定语从句修饰strategy；“such... that...”结构表示“如此...以至于”。
Because there is little organization, the movement doesn’t have much control over how participants act. Because / there is / little / organization, / the movement / doesn’t / have / much control / over / how / participants / act. 因为几乎没有组织，运动对参与者如何行动没有太大的控制权。 little: 几乎没有（否定）
control over: 对...的控制		 “little”与“a little”的区别。
But if it works, it’s a simple and cheap path to victory. But / if / it / works, / it’s / a simple / and / cheap path / to / victory. 但如果它奏效，这将是一条简单且廉价的胜利之路。 work: 奏效/起作用
cheap: 廉价的/低成本的		 “path to victory”通往胜利之路。

item.title: 日语学习 - サイバーパンクエッジランナーズE2 - 2026-05-02 05:49
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：3 分钟 (149 字符)

阅读解析 翻译参考 词汇 表达讲解
俺に / インストールして / くれ 给我安装上。 インストール：安装 「～てくれ」是「～てください」的粗鲁/命令表达，用于同辈或下属。
冗談 / だろ？ 开玩笑的吧？ 冗談（じょうだん）：玩笑 「だろ」是「だろう」的促音化，表示推测或确认。
売る / って / 話 / じゃなかった / か？ 不是说要卖掉吗？ 売る（うる）：卖
話（はなし）：谈话、内容		 「～って話」表示“关于……的说法/内容”。「じゃなかったか」用于确认过去约定的事实。
売らない 不卖。 売る（うる）：卖 动词否定简体形，语气生硬果断。
自分 / で / つけたい / んだ 是我自己想装上。 自分（じぶん）：自己
つける：安装、佩戴		 「～たい」表示欲望。「～んだ」用于强调自己的理由或主张。
やめ / とけ 算了吧/别做了。 やめる：停止、放弃 「～とけ」是「～ておけ」的口语省略，意为“事先做好某种状态”，此处指“保持不做的状态”。
そいつ / は / ただでさえ / 合う / 合わない / が / 激しい 那家伙（这东西）本来排异反应就很强烈。 ただでさえ：本来就、即便不那样也...
激しい（はげしい）：剧烈、强烈		 「合う合わない」指匹配度或排异反应。「激しい」形容程度非常深。
そのうえ / ガチ / の / 軍用 / だ 而且，这可是货真价实的军用品。 そのうえ：而且、再加上
ガチ：认真的、真正的
軍用（ぐんよう）：军用		 「ガチ」是年轻人常用的俚语，表示“真正的、硬核的”。
ガキ / が / 耐えられる / 代物 / じゃねえ / よ 这可不是小鬼能受得了的东西。 ガキ：小鬼、小屁孩
耐える（たえる）：忍受
代物（しろもの）：物品、东西		 「耐えられる」是可能形。「じゃねえ」是「ではない」的粗鲁口语。
カネ / さえ / 払えば / あんた / の / 知ったこと / じゃない / だろ 只要付了钱，就不关你的事了吧。 払う（はらう）：支付
知ったこと（しったこと）：关心的事、在乎的事		 「～さえ～ば」句型，表示“只要……就……”。「知ったことじゃない」意为“不关我的事/没兴趣管”。
カネ / なんか / … / 持って / ねえ / だろう / が 钱什么的……你根本就没有吧。 持つ（もつ）：持有、拥有 「なんか」表示轻蔑或举例。「ねえ」是「ない」的口语变体。结尾的「が」带有反驳或强调语气。
分かった / よ 知道了/行吧。 分かる（わかる）：明白、理解 用过去式「分かった」表示已经理解并接受现状。语气词「よ」带有妥协感。

item.title: 英语学习 - The Strategy of Protest and Revolution 1: Basic Elements (04/05/2020) - 2026-05-02 05:44
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：50 分钟 (2482 字符)

阅读解析 (意群划分) 翻译参考 核心词汇 表达讲解
Hi, / and welcome / to Strategy Stuff. 嗨，欢迎来到 Strategy Stuff。 Strategy: 策略/战略 标准的欢迎语结构。Stuff 在这里指“东西/频道内容”。
This is / a video series / on / The Strategy of Protest and Revolution, / where we’ll look at / how successful revolutionary and protest movements / have strategized / to achieve their political goals. 这是一个关于抗议和革命策略的视频系列，我们将探讨成功的革命和抗议运动是如何制定策略来实现其政治目标的。 Protest: 抗议
Revolution: 革命
Movement: 运动
Strategize: 制定战略		 where 引导定语从句修饰 series；how 引导宾语从句说明 look at 的内容。
First: / How do activists / turn / public discontent / into / a political movement? 第一：活动家们如何将公众的不满转化为政治运动？ Activist: 积极分子/活动家
Discontent: 不满		 turn A into B：将 A 转化为 B，是描述变化的核心短语。
Second: / How do movements / plan their action out / to achieve / their political goals? 第二：运动如何规划其行动以实现其政治目标？ Plan out: 详细计划/规划
Achieve: 实现		 plan out 强调计划的完整性和细节。
And third, / how have successful strategies / changed / with time? 第三，成功的策略是如何随时间变化的？ With time: 随着时间推移 使用现在完成时 have changed 表示从过去到现在持续的变化过程。
Over this series, / we’ll answer these questions / by looking at / various historical movements. 在这个系列中，我们将通过观察各种历史运动来回答这些问题。 Various: 各种各样的
Historical: 历史的		 by doing sth：通过某种手段或方式。
But / before we do that, / let’s first structure our thinking / by examining / the basic elements / within a strategy / of protest and revolution. 但在那之前，让我们先通过研究抗议和革命策略中的基本要素来构建我们的思路。 Structure: 构建/组织
Examine: 审查/研究
Element: 要素		 structure our thinking：使思维条理化。
Definitions 定义 Definition: 定义 小标题。
Protests and revolutions / are both / what sociologists call / social movements. 抗议和革命都是社会学家所称的社会运动。 Sociologist: 社会学家 what sociologists call：名词性从句，作表语。
The key characteristic / they share / is collective action, / where / ordinary people / band together / to push political demands / against establishment interests, / which are / usually backed by state power. 它们共有的关键特征是集体行动，即普通人团结起来，针对通常由国家权力支持的既得利益集团提出政治诉求。 Characteristic: 特征
Collective: 集体的
Band together: 团结/结合
Establishment: 既得利益阶层/权势集团
Backed by: 由...支持		 Establishment 指现存的社会统治结构或权力机构。
Members of the establishment / may lead a movement, / but / it is ordinary people / who ultimately provide / the driving force, / and that’s what differentiates / social movements / from coups, / which are / completely driven by / members of the establishment. 既得利益集团的成员可能会领导一场运动，但最终提供动力的是普通民众，这就是社会运动与政变的区别，政变完全是由既得利益集团成员驱动的。 Ultimately: 最终
Driving force: 驱动力
Differentiate: 区分
Coup: 政变 (发音 /kuː/)		 it is... who...：强调句型。differentiate A from B：区分 A 和 B。
There are many ways / to explain / why a social movement succeeds, / but / since this is a strategy channel, / we’ll focus on / the process / of protest and revolution, / looking at / how movements took / what they had / and turned it into victory. 有很多方法可以解释为什么社会运动会成功，但既然这是一个策略频道，我们将专注于抗议和革命的过程，看看运动是如何利用现有的资源并将其转化为胜利的。 Focus on: 专注于
Process: 过程
Victory: 胜利		 since 在这里引导原因状语从句，意为“既然/因为”。
At the most basic level, / the social movement process / takes the input / of public participation / and converts it / into the output / of political power. 在最基本的层面上，社会运动过程获取公众参与的投入，并将其转化为政治权力的产出。 Participation: 参与
Convert: 转化
Input/Output: 输入/输出		 convert A into B：将 A 转化/变换为 B。
The establishment / looks at that power / and has two options: / it can decide / that it’s not possible / or worth it / to match that power, / leading to / negotiation and compromise; / or it can increase / its own power / to outmatch the movement, / leading to suppression / or, in the event of / complete failure, / a revolution. 既得利益集团审视这种权力并有两种选择：它可以决定不可能或不值得去抗衡这种权力，从而导致谈判和妥协；或者它可以增加自己的力量来压倒运动，从而导致镇压，或者在完全失败的情况下，导致革命。 Worth it: 值得
Match: 抗衡/匹配
Negotiation: 谈判
Compromise: 妥协
Outmatch: 胜过/压倒
Suppression: 镇压		 leading to：分词结构作结果状语。in the event of：万一/如果发生某事。
Either way, / the more power / a movement has, / the higher / its chances of success. 无论哪种方式，运动拥有的权力越多，成功的机会就越高。 Either way: 无论如何
Chance: 机会		 the more..., the higher...：越……，就越……（比较级句型）。
So / how can a movement / increase its power? / Looking again / at the social movement process, / we see two ways / to do so: / we either increase / the amount of input, / or we increase / the rate of conversion / into output. 那么，运动如何增加其权力呢？再次观察社会运动的过程，我们看到两种方法：要么增加投入量，要么提高转化为产出的效率。 Rate: 速率/比例
Conversion: 转化		 either... or...：要么……要么……（两者选其一）。
In practical terms, / this means / we either get / more of the public / to participate, / or we get / our existing participants / to contribute / more political power. 从实际角度来看，这意味着我们要么让更多的公众参与，要么让现有的参与者贡献更多的政治力量。 Practical terms: 实际情况/实际而言
Existing: 现有的
Contribute: 贡献		 get someone to do something：使/让某人做某事。
These two / fundamental options / form the skeleton / of a social movement / grand strategy. 这两个基本选项构成了社会运动大战略的骨架。 Fundamental: 基本的/根本的
Skeleton: 骨架/纲要
Grand strategy: 大战略		 form the skeleton of：构成……的框架/基础。
Grand Strategy: / Issues vs Organization 大战略：议题 vs 组织 Issue: 议题/问题
Organization: 组织		 vs: 经常用于对比两个对立或相关的概念。
